name: Tiket per Bulan
query:
SELECT
	DATE_FORMAT(`tabNextHD Ticket`.creation, '%%Y-%%m') AS "Bulan:Data:150",
	COUNT(`tabNextHD Ticket`.name) AS "Tiket Baru:Int:100",
	SUM(CASE WHEN `tabNextHD Ticket`.status = 'Selesai' AND YEAR(`tabNextHD Ticket`.resolved_on) = %(year)s THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "Tiket Selesai:Int:100",
	SUM(CASE WHEN `tabNextHD Ticket`.status = 'Ditutup' AND YEAR(`tabNextHD Ticket`.closed_on) = %(year)s THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "Tiket Ditutup:Int:100"
FROM
	`tabNextHD Ticket`
WHERE
	YEAR(`tabNextHD Ticket`.creation) = %(year)s
	AND (%(team)s IS NULL OR `tabNextHD Ticket`.team = %(team)s)
GROUP BY
	DATE_FORMAT(`tabNextHD Ticket`.creation, '%%Y-%%m')
ORDER BY
	DATE_FORMAT(`tabNextHD Ticket`.creation, '%%Y-%%m')
